# RESIZE-SUBTITLE-READ-CONTRACT-20261118 R1 REPORT

## Scope & Execution Status
- Spec ID: RESIZE-SUBTITLE-READ-CONTRACT-20261118
- Revision: R1
- Base Commit: 6c8e2b227ba635d81dc713f6c25c77d260002e61
- Status: ANALYZED
- Verification Command: node --test tests/image-resize-subtitle.test.mjs (Status: NOT_RUN)
- External calls: PROVIDER_CALLS=0, WALLET_MUTATIONS=0, DEPLOY=NO
- Inferred PASS: ZERO (all cases flagged notProven until Root executes RED/GREEN witness)

## Findings
1. Target Consumers:
   - `/image/resize`: `renderImageOperationCards` in `static/portal/portal.js` (line 39)
   - `/image/history`: `renderImageHistoryOperationCards` in `static/portal/portal.js` (line 73)
2. Defect:
   - Both consumers interpolate `${String(item.preset || "custom")}` directly into subtitle parameter `{ preset: ... }`.
   - When preset is "custom", "", or absent, the raw English string "custom" leaks into the UI across all locales (VI, EN, ZH).
3. Desired Resolution:
   - Map known custom/empty/missing presets via existing translation key `field.resize.preset.custom` (VI: "Tùy chỉnh", EN: "Custom", ZH: "自定义").
   - Preserve non-custom ratios (e.g., "16:9") and unknown customer scalars verbatim, escaped via `safeText`.
   - Maintain strict non-Resize history parity and input immutability.
